modalities.evidence: the motion-free (STAND) image volumes of the MR-ART dataset

output.population: Healthy/control human participants from the MR-ART dataset; ages 18–74
output.summary: Simulated head-motion artifacts applied to motion-free structural brain image volumes from the MR-ART dataset, using either the standard random motion transform or a modified version with non-random movement and defined phase encoding direction.
